+== Producing documents
+The producer runs the operation of the `operation` option: `CCB_PUT` (the default) stores the message body as the
+document with the id of the `CamelCouchbaseId` header, `CCB_GET` reads the document of that id, and `CCB_DEL` deletes
+it. The producer removes the `CamelCouchbaseId` header after each call, so set it again before the next one.
+`CCB_PUT` stores the body as JSON: a Map, a List or a POJO becomes a JSON document, and text is stored as a JSON string,
+so unmarshal JSON text to a Map first. A byte array, a stream or no body fail. After the call the message body is `true`
+for `CCB_PUT`, the `GetResult` of the Couchbase SDK for `CCB_GET`, and the `MutationResult` as text for `CCB_DEL`.
== Couchbase SDK compatibility
Using collections and scopes is supported only for Couchbase Server 7.0 and later.
